gloss: to behave; to conduct oneself; to treat to

definitions.explanation: To act in a certain manner, especially in social situations.
To offer food or drink to others as a host.

examples.japanese: {大人|おとな}らしく{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}いなさい。
{何|なに}も{知|し}らないふりをして{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}った。
examples.english: I acted as if I knew nothing.

examples.japanese: {友人|ゆうじん}が{手作|てづく}りのケーキを{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}ってくれた。
examples.english: My friend treated us to homemade cake.

notes:
{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}う has two distinct meanings: behavior and hospitality. Both are common in everyday usage.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Sense 1 (behave): intransitive ({自動詞|じどうし})
- Sense 2 (treat to): transitive ({他動詞|たどうし})

ASPECT (ている):
{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}っている indicates ongoing behavior or acting a certain way.

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- [manner]に{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}う — to behave in [manner]
- [person]に[food]を{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}う — to treat [person] to [food]

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {普通|ふつう}に{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}う (behave normally)
- {紳士的|しんしてき}に{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}う (conduct oneself like a gentleman)
- {料理|りょうり}を{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}う (serve food to guests)

NOUN FORM:
{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}い means "behavior" or "conduct," and also "treat" or "feast."
